summary: Fix Controller backup relay statuses, credential destination validation and the paged backup UI consumers, and delete the older-Core fallbacks (catalog/run arrays, access-based health, policy-update capability gate) and the backup page handshake. API impact: changed contract.

guide.reason: Operators now see destination fields validated before Save and a retention preview scoped to the chosen repository; older-master upgrade notes are removed.

api.reason: POST /api/v1/storage/credentials requires repository for a backup-purpose offer and refuses an invalid destination or SMB3 username with '='; POST backup-repositories requires id for non-NFS kinds; the backup-catalog/backup-runs relay returns only Core pages, 503 for stale or non-master Core and Core 503, 400 for Core 400, and 404 for an unknown pool. ReportResponse drops backup_support, backup_inventory_pages and pool_membership_hostname; ManagedState drops backup_catalog and backup_runs; Core no longer advertises backup-v1 or backup-inventory-pages-v1 and has no backup-history-api health check.

roadmap.reason: Review fixes inside the current destination acceptance slice.

state.reason: No new durable record. Health and pages are recomputed from Core reports; policies, repositories and credentials stay on Core, so a fresh Controller loses nothing.

verification.method: Focused Controller tests passed, including an end-to-end relay through a real stats channel; with the staged Controller sources through go test -overlay the relay, policy-revision and receipt tests failed. web npm test and tsc --noEmit passed. The lab script changes compile (py_compile) but were not run.
verification.limits: No browser walkthrough, lab run or mixed-version hardware run was performed for this batch; forge CI remains open.
